name: CSnCompany_2-0
description: CSnCOMPANY — A virtual AI team for Claude Code. Each plugin is a teammate (CEO / PM / Architect / Designer / QA / Reviewer / DevOps) that takes you from idea to ship.

plugins.name: cs-end
plugins.description: 🏁 Session Closer — 세션 학습 게이트 + 프로젝트 로컬 AgentsToZ 장기기억 에이전트 위임 + 선택적 버전업. (/cs-end)

plugins.name: cs-error-notes
plugins.description: 📝 Error Note Manager — Captures errors with 상황/문제점/시도/원인/해결점 5-field structure. Auto-integrates with cs-end Phase 2.2. Search, pattern analysis, and human-readable archive. (/cs-error-notes)

plugins.name: cs-ceo
plugins.description: 🧭 CEO — AgentsToZ 프로젝트 기억과 활성 제약을 임무 분할 전에 회상하고 CS 파트너에 자율 배분.

plugins.name: goal
plugins.description: 🎯 Goal — /goal with Goal Gate built-in. Clarifies goal first, then auto-dispatches to the best CS-series domain via cs-ceo.

plugins.name: cs-partnership
plugins.description: 🤝 Partnership — /cs-partnership with [skills/agents] [goal]. v5.5: AGENT type (executor, debugger, architect) directly calls external plugin agents via Task(subagent_type). SKILL/PROTOCOL types use Skill() or direct execution.

plugins.name: cs-clarify
plugins.description: 💬 PM — Requirements clarification before planning. 4-agent Socratic elicitation surfaces hidden assumptions, validates scope, prevents over-engineering.

plugins.name: CS-plan
plugins.description: 🏗️ Architect — TDD + Clean Architecture 4-agent planner. Domain analysis, architecture design, test strategy, implementation checklist.

plugins.name: cs-design
plugins.description: 🎨 Designer — 5-agent parallel design review + claude.ai/design-quality generation (--gen). oklch() palette, ec-* namespace, self-contained HTML or Next.js TSX output.

plugins.name: cs-design-sample1
plugins.description: 🎨 Design Reference — CS Archive token system: paper (warm cream + deep teal, default) ↔ dark (near-black + cyan) re-skin. Audit & apply to Next.js study/content apps.

plugins.name: cs-design-sample2
plugins.description: 🎨 Design Reference — Dark editorial/terminal style: near-black navy + cyan accent, mono/serif pairing. Audit & apply to Next.js dark content sites.

plugins.name: CS-test
plugins.description: 🧪 QA Engineer — 14-agent web testing: security, SEO, performance, accessibility, DB, PWA, touch, image optimization.

plugins.name: CS-codebase-review
plugins.description: 🔍 Code Reviewer — 5-agent parallel review: Architecture, Quality, Security, Performance, Maintainability.

plugins.name: cs-ship
plugins.description: 🚢 DevOps — Pre-PR validation gate. 4-agent team checks spec compliance, coverage, commit-message quality before merge.

plugins.name: cs-smart-run
plugins.description: ⚡ Team Lead — Two-phase orchestrator: plan with Opus → execute with Sonnet agents in parallel.

plugins.name: cs-experiencing
plugins.description: 📚 Knowledge Backend — cs-memory가 검증된 교훈을 관련 CS 에이전트에 반영할 때 사용하는 내부 저장소.

plugins.name: convo-maker
plugins.description: 🗣️ Language Coach — Convert session Q&A into natural American English conversations for language learning.

plugins.name: cs-memory
plugins.description: 🧠 Memory Learner — AgentsToZ 기억 변화만 무토큰 수집하고 비중복 컴팩트 교훈으로 관련 에이전트를 강화

plugins.name: csn-sync
plugins.description: 🔄 Marketplace Sync — keep CSnCompany_2-0 in sync across Claude Code and Codex via GitHub. Regenerates per-plugin .codex-plugin manifests, bumps versions, mirrors the Codex cache, and does safe git pull/push. (/csn-sync)
